handshake.reveal_note: The real photo is a candid close-up: natural soft blur, and the paper on the desk has real lines of text. The AI version is a glossy portrait with a generic blurred skyline, and the clasped hands look small and soft next to the sharp faces and suits.

laptop-typing.reveal_note: Check the keyboard. On the real laptop every key legend is crisp and the layout is consistent. On the AI laptop the key labels dissolve into smudges, and the screen reflects a keyboard and fingers that don't match what is in front of it.

meeting-room.reveal_note: The real room is full of consistent, believable detail: ceiling grid and vents, a desk phone, and a frosted-glass pattern that repeats properly. The AI room is oddly clean and symmetrical, the ceiling light is a thin cross hanging from nothing, and the chairs don't quite match each other.

phone-call.subject_label: Taking a phone call at a desk
phone-call.reveal_note: The real photo is an unposed moment with messy, specific detail: sticky notes, a mug, paper trays and real icons on the monitor. The AI executive is stock-photo perfect, with flawless lighting, a generic skyline, and a chart and notebook that look right from a distance but say nothing up close.

server-room.reveal_note: The real shot is a soft close-up of one server with a few green status lights. The AI racks are packed with detail that doesn't hold up: cables that loop and tangle without clearly ending at a port, tiny screens and labels with no readable text, and units that don't line up.

video-call.subject_label: A video call on a laptop
video-call.reveal_note: The real photo shows a slightly blurry, awkward call, which is how video calls actually look. In the AI image the laptop is turned so its screen faces the camera rather than the person using it, and the call tiles are tiny and warped, with a stray white shape over the man in the bottom tile.

hands-typing.reveal_note: The AI image has two keyboards on the desk and fingers that look long and uneven, against a smooth glowing blur. The real photo is ordinary hands on one keyboard, with a mug, a monitor and a messy cable behind them.

parcel-handover.reveal_note: The AI image is a posed portrait of a masked courier in front of a stack of identical, spotless boxes. The real photo is a candid close-up of a hand signing on a clipboard next to a box with printed text.

phone-street.reveal_note: The AI man has smooth, even skin, a tidy jacket and a blurred stone wall that looks painted on. The real photo is a candid crop of hands, a watch and a belt, with a real car blurred behind.

woman-laptop.reveal_note: The AI woman looks straight at the camera with flawless skin, and her laptop lid has no logo, ports or detail. The real photo is a candid side view, with real keys, a desk lamp and a messy plait.
